Placeholders like `${openmrsSpaBase}` are resolved at runtime by `interpolateUrl()` in `esm-navigation`. It does a literal string replacement of `${openmrsBase}`, `${openmrsSpaBase}`, and any caller-supplied parameters. Most O3 call sites go through it: config loading, `navigate()`, `ConfigurableLink`, and logo and background images.

**How it works**

- `interpolateUrl()` reads `window.getOpenmrsSpaBase()`, strips the trailing slash, and passes `openmrsBase`, `openmrsSpaBase`, and any `additionalParams` to `interpolateString()`. That helper splits and joins on each literal `${key}`, so unknown placeholders are left in place. It also collapses a leading `//` to `/` unless the template itself started with `//`, so `/${openmrsSpaBase}` does not become a protocol-relative URL. (packages/framework/esm-navigation/src/navigation/interpolate-string.ts:37-48, 66-69)
- `navigate()` calls `interpolateUrl(to, templateParams)` first, then either does an in-SPA navigation or `window.location.assign`. (packages/framework/esm-navigation/src/navigation/navigate.ts:50-64)
- `ConfigurableLink` renders `href={interpolateUrl(to, templateParams)}`. (packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/ConfigurableLink.tsx:66-74)
- The app shell interpolates each `configUrls` entry before fetching it. (packages/shell/esm-app-shell/src/run.ts:257-261)
- Config validation rejects any `${...}` that is not `openmrsBase`, `openmrsSpaBase`, or a parameter the caller declared. (packages/framework/esm-config/src/validators/validators.ts:15-47)
- Tests cover the expected outputs and the `//evil.example` case. (packages/framework/esm-navigation/src/navigation/interpolate-string.test.ts:1-25)

**Documentation**

- Developer docs for `interpolateUrl` and `navigate`, both generated from the source comments. (packages/framework/esm-framework/docs/functions/interpolateUrl.md:9-28; packages/framework/esm-framework/docs/functions/navigate.md:27-41)
- Operator docs: `configUrls` supports `${openmrsSpaBase}` and `${openmrsBase}`, interpolated via `interpolateUrl()` at runtime. (content/en-US/docs/configure-o3/overview.mdx:369)
- Branding examples for logo `link` and background `image`, and service-queue and patient-management URL templates. (content/en-US/docs/configure-o3/configure-branding.mdx:135-212; content/en-US/docs/configure-o3/configure-patient-management.mdx:429-468, 711)
- The `openmrs` tooling README covers `configUrls` with `${openmrsSpaBase}`. (packages/tooling/openmrs/README.md:213)

**Gaps**

- I did not find the production definition of `window.getOpenmrsSpaBase`. The hits I saw were test setups and mocks, and `esm-framework/mock.tsx` sets it from `window.spaBase`. The real definition is probably in the shell or the build tooling, but I did not confirm it.
- I did not check whether the `openmrsBase` global is always set before `interpolateUrl` runs.
